metadata.description: AST-expansion conformance fixture for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2y_6_dirichlet_bc: a minimal consuming model binding NX=4, NY=8 at the import edge. The compound match D(D(u,y),y) fires (priority 10) through the section-9.6.3 fixpoint and lowers to the rule's makearray — interior rows [4,5] (all i) holding the imported 7-point sixth-order y second-difference stencil aggregate, the six y-face rows j in {1,2,3,6,7,8} over the (NX x 1) strips holding the sixth-order one-sided dirichlet closures (face1/face2/face3) carrying the free names gB, gT and dy — with all metaparameters folded. x0=y0=0 and dx=1/4, dy=1/8; the dx/dy expressions are spelled with literals because the edge binding closes NX/NY before this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm). The golden pins the byte-identical post-lowering AST across bindings.
metadata.name: central_D2y_6_dirichlet_bc_ast_fixture

central_D2y_6_dirichlet_face1.description: D2 = (86016 g - 136136 f1 + 56628 f2 - 3861 f3 - 5720 f4 + 4290 f5 - 1404 f6 + 187 f7) / (25740 dy^2). g is the y-wall value; f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

central_D2y_6_dirichlet_face2.description: D2 = (-2048 g + 11349 f1 - 17745 f2 + 8073 f3 + 1170 f4 - 1105 f5 + 351 f6 - 45 f7) / (7020 dy^2). g is the y-wall value; f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

central_D2y_6_dirichlet_face3.description: D2 = (4096 g - 17589 f1 + 121836 f2 - 216216 f3 + 120120 f4 - 13585 f5 + 1404 f6 - 66 f7) / (77220 dy^2). g is the y-wall value; f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

x_coord.description: Cell-center x-coordinates x_i = x0 + (i - 1/2) dx, shaped over the x index set. x0 and dx are free names supplied by the consuming model (see metadata.description for the contract).

y_coord.description: Cell-center y-coordinates y_j = y0 + (j - 1/2) dy, shaped over the y index set. y0 and dy are free names supplied by the consuming model (see metadata.description for the contract).

dx.description: x-spacing 1/NX = 1/4, spelled with the literal 4: the import edge binds NX, closing it before this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm contract).

dy.description: y-spacing 1/NY = 1/8, spelled with the literal 8: the import edge binds NY.

gB.description: Prescribed field value on the bottom y-wall y=y0 (the rule's Dirichlet free name). Zero default = homogeneous bottom wall.

gT.description: Prescribed field value on the top y-wall (the rule's Dirichlet free name), nonzero so the inhomogeneous face term appears in the expanded golden.

u.description: Temperature field over the 2-D [x, y] index sets.

x0.description: Left x domain edge a = 0: the grid's x0 free name (consumer-supplied geometry contract).

y0.description: Bottom y domain edge: the grid's y0 free name.
